changes.title: New API endpoint guarded by a permission: POST /api/customers/ibs/remove-from-batch
changes.risk_reason: New capability; confirm the guard matches the permission the PRD/story names.

plain.headline: New protected action: Creating or running customers › ibs › remove from batch
plain.what: There is a new action in the app (creating or running customers › ibs › remove from batch). Only people with one of 7 permissions (for example “Customers — Create & Edit” or “Customers — View”) can use it.
plain.why: A new feature: make sure the right people can use it and nobody else can.
check: Log in as someone whose role has one of the permissions listed and try it: it should work.
Log in as someone whose role has none of them and try it: it should be blocked, and the button or page should not be shown.

qa_scenarios: API authorisation: call POST /api/customers/ibs/remove-from-batch as a role WITH and a role WITHOUT "Customers — Create & Edit" — expect 2xx and 403.
Front end: the matching screen action is shown only to roles the API allows (front end blocks + back end allows = pass; the reverse is a defect).
Cross-role: try the same call as each system role whose defaults include or exclude the permission.

changes.title: Screens that use "Invoicing & Payments — Create & Edit" changed
changes.risk_reason: Front end now reads this permission in different places — a screen may show/hide differently.

plain.headline: Screens that depend on “Invoicing & Payments — Create & Edit” changed
plain.what: The app now shows or hides things based on this permission in a different set of places (before: 1, now: 2).
plain.why: A button, menu item or page may now appear or disappear for some people.
check: Log in as someone with “Invoicing & Payments — Create & Edit”: the related buttons, menus and pages are shown and work.
Log in as someone without it: they are hidden.

qa_scenarios: Screens: open the screens listed and confirm controls tied to "Invoicing & Payments — Create & Edit" show/hide/disable correctly for a role with and without it.
Nav: top-level navigation items for the area appear only for roles holding the permission.
